description: Pixeltable: session orientation + real-time anti-pattern validation (pure Python; the command finds a 3.9+ interpreter as python, python3, or py -3).

hooks.command: sh -c 'for p in python python3 "py -3"; do $p -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec $p "$0"; done; exit 0' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_orientation.py"

sh -c 'for p in python python3 "py -3"; do $p -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec $p "$0"; done; exit 0' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/validate_antipatterns.py"
